lines.en: Didn't we, hey Sevda,
promise and swear,

lines.cyr: ни да се мажиш, Севдо мори,
lines.lat: ni da se mažiš, Sevdo mori,
lines.en: that you will not marry, hey Sevda,
and I will not marry?

lines.cyr: Леле, лепа мори, ни да се женам.
lines.lat: Lele, lepa mori, ni da se ženam.
lines.en: Hey, pretty, I will not marry.

lines.cyr: Ти да ме чекаш, Севдо мори,
lines.lat: Ti da me čekaš, Sevdo mori,
lines.en: You were supposed to wait for me, hey Sevda,
up to three years,

lines.cyr: ти не ме чека, Севдо мори,
lines.lat: ti ne me čeka, Sevdo mori,
lines.en: but you didn't wait for me, hey Sevda,
not even for three weeks.

lines.cyr: Леле, лепа мори, ни три недели.
lines.lat: Lele, lepa mori, ni tri nedeli.
lines.en: Hey, pretty, not for three weeks.
I went to Solun, hey Sevda,
and I received some news,
that you are engaged to be married, hey Sevda,
to my little godfather.

lines.cyr: Леле, лепа мори, за мојто кумче.
lines.lat: Lele, lepa mori, za mojto kumče.
lines.en: Hey, pretty, to my little godfather.
I am invited, hey Sevda,
to be your godfather at the wedding,
but my hands, hey Sevda,
can't hold the flowers.

lines.cyr: Леле, лепа мори, венци да држам.
lines.lat: Lele, lepa mori, venci da držam.
lines.en: Hey, pretty, can't hold the flowers.
I said with my mouth, hey Sevda,
"may you be happy",
I am saying with my heart, hey Sevda,
"may you be mine again".

lines.cyr: Леле, лепа мори, пак моја да си.
lines.lat: Lele, lepa mori, pak moja da si.
lines.en: Hey, pretty, may you be mine again.
